Appendix 34: Deferred Portal settlement and
scheduled pDAI accumulation
Contents of this appendix
Evidence and assumptions ...................................................................................................................................... 221
Complete examined 86ff V3 debt ............................................................................................................................ 221
Atomic repayment and continuing Portal exposure ................................................................................................. 222
Caps and authority .................................................................................................................................................. 223
Five independent clocks .......................................................................................................................................... 223

Source record: docs/studies/analysis/pulsechain_deferred_campaign_20260930.md.
Deferred Portal settlement and scheduled pDAI accumulation
30 September 2026. This study examines a coordinated PulseChain campaign that repays matching
borrower debts, buys in small scheduled amounts, operates connected Curve liquidity and funds
eventual backing from collected income. It establishes the complete examined V3 debt census and
several code and configuration constraints. It does not establish an operating end-to-end campaign, the
source chain's balances, common ownership or a durable dollar peg.
Evidence and assumptions
All fresh chain reads use chain 369, block 27,675,130, hash 
0xdd12f23ad571882b63fd333c5d3909a45a05fe6f0a3c2b273cb7e1e6b0917954, timestamp 30 September 2026
05:20:55 UTC. Header rechecks agree after each batch. Read-only eth_call queries collect balances,
configurations, routes and quotes; code and implementation storage are read without overrides. No
transaction was signed, broadcast, or simulated as a state-changing call. The strategy tests are view
calls with hypothetical accounting arguments.
The scenario assumes coordinated control, authorized destination bridge issuance, sufficient supply and
unbacked caps, usable account execution, market acceptance and sufficient route liquidity. Trading
budgets are 44bn DAI, 60bn USDC and 50bn USDT units, separate from the issuance allocated to
borrower repayment. These are not dollar valuations. Multi-year tolerance, net earnings, trade amounts
and an independent dollar reference are modeling assumptions. Across metacoin delivery is not
established by these observations.
Complete examined 86ff V3 debt
Account: 0xe6df4ca976f3fec8da89efec332dc2245f0a86ff. The current getReservesList returns the same 17 assets
as the earlier census. Each current getReserveData identifies its debt and receipt contracts; all balance
queries use those contracts at the same block. USDC and USDT use six decimals, WBTC eight and the
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 221

other listed assets eighteen. All 17 stable-debt balances are zero. The individually decoded debts
reconcile exactly to the account's aggregate debt under its sampled oracle prices. T welve variable-debt
balances are nonzero:
Underlying asset Variable debt in token units, rounded except cbETH
pDAI 136,922,803.834140
pUSDC 261,016,418.599713
pUSDT 187,090,022.959893
pWBTC 43,836,589.082845
LINK 3,841,442,884.551383
CRV 23,014,632,202.924069
MKR 2,166,349.981530
SNX 954,043.355941
BAL 27,993,956.678406
UNI 10,167,590.111045
LDO 23,187,809.019895
cbETH 0.000000000000001435
WETH, wstETH, AAVE, rETH and LUSD have zero debt in this account. WETH is its sole nonzero aT oken
holding, approximately 105,220.502652 aWETH. Sampled WETH underlying cash exceeds that
holding. Exact raw integers, all omitted zero positions, reserve totals and actual cash are retained in 
model.json. The V2 account getter still reverts; no V2 zero-debt finding is inferred.
The debt balances include accrued interest and are not original borrowed cash, recoverable collateral or
evidence of equivalent underlying issuance. Debt in different assets cannot be summed without a
specified valuation. Inherited oracle valuations do not establish executable dollars.
Atomic repayment and continuing Portal exposure
The current pool proxy still identifies implementation 0xf1cd4193bbc1ad4a23e833170f49d60f3d35a621. Fresh
explorer-verified source lists its linked BridgeLogic at 0x57572c9e795f4b6a748efbeab7e0a1b9996a0a24. That
library's verified source matches the pool's included BridgeLogic source. Current runtime reads for both
are retained. Its mint operation invokes ordinary supply validation, increments aggregate reserve.unbacked,
checks the cap, updates rates and mints the recognized destination aT oken. Verified pool source, verified
linked library.
Assume an authorized bridge issues each matching V3 receipt to 86ff and that 86ff can legitimately
make its own repayment calls. repayWithATokens reduces the matching borrower debt and burns its receipts
without supplying underlying cash. It does not reduce reserve.unbacked. This method is for the calling
account, whereas ordinary underlying repayment can name a beneficiary. The existence of a token-
transfer facility does not prove arbitrary Aave execution.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 222

The twelve repayments can be considered as one destination batch, conditional on account support,
validation, runtime interest, scaled-balance rounding and gas. The cbETH remainder must be reconciled
even though economically tiny; an aT oken mint of too few raw units can fail scaled-unit rounding. A
successful all-debt repayment removes debt-based withdrawal constraints but does not give the payer
ownership of collateral. No such batch was executed or simulated here.
For each asset X, the proposed debt restructuring is:
authorized destination mint of aX
    -> caller burns matching aX against its X debt
    -> borrower X debt falls; reserve cash is unchanged
    -> equal Portal X principal remains to be backed
Separate receipts sold through wrappers cannot also be burned in repayment. Allocations and retained
claims must be consolidated across controlled accounts. The previous repayment and rights audit
(Appendix 21) and Portal ledger (Appendix 17) explain these rights.
Caps and authority
All 17 current unbacked caps are zero, so positive Portal issuance fails under the observed configuration.
Ordinary supply caps apply to issuance as well; raising the unbacked cap alone is insufficient. Every
nonzero debt plus its separate campaign allocation fits the standard 36-bit unbacked-cap encoding
maximum of 68,719,476,735 whole underlying units in its own reserve. For DAI, USDC and USDT the
combined new amounts are approximately 44.137bn, 60.261bn and 50.187bn. Other bridges and prior
unbacked amounts share that reserve's headroom. Encoding feasibility is not actual mint authorization
or liquidity.
The fresh provider returns ACL Manager 0xc2aacf6553d20d1e9d78e365aaba8032af9c85b0. Its reported ACL admin
and provider owner are short executor 0xee56e2b3d491590b5b31738cc34d5232f378a8d5. isPoolAdmin(shortExecutor)
returns true. Executor getAdmin remains governance 0xec568fffba86c094cf06b22134b23074dfe2252c; 
getPendingAdmin remains 0xa30190b96faee0080144aa0b7645081fcbf49e6f. Delay and minimum delay both return
86,400 seconds. The standard setter cannot set the delay below its minimum; once the operating
permissions exist, individual market operations do not each require this administrative delay.
Five independent clocks
Clock Finding and significance
Administrative activation Current executor delay 86,400 seconds; acceptance and
actual authority are separate.
pARB assertion confirmation confirmPeriodBlocks returns 45,818; elapsed time also
depends on chain progress and challenges.
Across bundle liveness Current HubPool liveness returns 7,200 seconds. This is
not total reimbursement latency or a Portal maturity.
Trading campaign Proposed eligible ten-second observation slots; pauses,
block inclusion and execution are additional constraints.
Eventual Aave backing Inspected BridgeLogic contains no per-mint maturity or
automatic collection; exact integration terms remain
separate.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 223

Unbacked principal is increased by mints and reduced by explicit backing; this entry has no independent
interest-index update. Receipt balances can still accrue liquidity-index interest. The backing library
accepts a fee argument and allocates it; it does not encode a universal time-based penalty or enforce
payment at fourteen days. An integrating bridge can impose fees and deadlines. Original Portal
documentation describes temporary advances, not an entitlement to permanent funding. Portal design.
An unchanged exposure may therefore persist in state for years. That is an implementation possibility,
not a demonstrated operating arrangement. It continues consuming capacity; suppliers still hold claims,
withdrawals still require cash, and governance or market acceptance may change. A bridge message or
an ordinary Aave deposit does not discharge this aggregate obligation.
Earning over years
Removing borrower debt stops its future interest contribution. 86ff accounts for 100% of sampled LDO
debt, about 99.9946% of UNI debt, 99.7430% of SNX debt, 91.1897% of LINK debt and 45.2012% of CRV
debt. It is not the sole borrower in every reserve. Remaining collectible external debts can still support
income; the repayment itself does not manufacture it.
The configured DAI strategy lacks explorer-verified source. Instead, three view calls test its actual current
response with controlled input arguments: 100 underlying units of hypothetical cash, a 10% reserve
factor, zero stable debt, then varying variable debt and unbacked amount. They return:
Variable debt Unbacked Liquidity rate per year Variable borrow rate per
year
100 0 1.125% 2.5%
100 1,000 0.1875% 2.5%
0 1,000 0% 0%
No reserves or balances were modified. These results establish behavior for the tested arguments, not a
full strategy source audit, a guarantee of income collection, or rates for every other asset. They agree
with the inherited architecture in which unbacked supply dilutes the liquidity utilization ratio. 
Architecture reference.
LP fees, external borrowing payments and realizable rewards can be additional funding streams if the
system owns the corresponding earning claim. Internal fees cancel on consolidation. Burned LP positions
provide no withdrawable system entitlement; eligible owned LP positions may earn staking incentives.
Reward sales require market depth and can affect reward prices. Lending interest booked against
uncollectible borrowers is not spendable fee cash.
For a fixed obligation M and exclusively owned productive assets A, assuming constant net collectible
annual yield y and reinvestment, assets grow as A(t) = A(0) * (1 + y)^t. Spendable assets, issuer claims
and backing obligations must be tracked in the actual asset denominations. The normalized model
assumes one asset and no losses, new issuance, additional outside claims or term changes.
With M=100 and A(0)=80, 5% yield reaches 100 total assets in 4.57 years. Consuming those assets
leaves zero capital in this modeled portfolio. Requiring income alone to pay 100 while preserving the
original 80 instead needs assets of 180 and takes 16.62 years. At 10%, the corresponding times are 2.34
and 8.51 years. Zero yield never fills a shortfall. These are sensitivity examples, not PulseChain yield
forecasts. A price rise in an asset owed can enlarge the cost of any missing backing; the portfolio
benefits from its net owned exposure.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 224

Partial income-funded backing is also possible and restores some headroom earlier, but reduces the
income left for reinvestment. That competing allocation is not simulated by the simple endpoint
examples. Interim withdrawal demands, realized losses and the tradeoff with peg-support reserves
remain decisive.
Consistent buying every ten seconds
One eligible slot deploys a fixed input amount; the acquired pDAI varies with the quote. At 8,640 slots
per day, spending a 50bn-input-unit budget at 1,000, 10,000 or 100,000 units per slot takes 5,787.04,
578.70 or 57.87 active days. Half-duty eligibility doubles calendar time. The policy pauses at the target,
adverse quotes, insufficient input inventory or required liquidity reserves. This is a schedule, not proof of
executable depth or a dollar anchor.
Time slicing reduces the size of one intervention and permits intervening flows. It does not erase
cumulative impact on unreplenished reserves. The offline example starts with one million units on each
side of a constant-product pool and spends one million input units. With zero fees, one trade and 100
trades both acquire 500,000 output units. At a 0.29% fee, one trade acquires 499,273.947223 units and
100 trades acquire 498,997.538504. No sellers or arbitrage replenish that example. Favorable
intervening flow or added liquidity, after costs, is what can improve realized campaign execution.
Outside sellers replenish the desired token while taking payment assets. Arbitrage can redirect demand
between venues but may also trade against a predictable buyer. Additional keeper transactions require
gas; scheduled observations need not all result in submitted transactions. The actual policy needs
complete route quotes and a consolidated liquidity/settlement budget.
Across delivery and Curve rebalancing
Fresh getters identify 3pool's coins as pDAI/pUSDC/pUSDT, and FRAXBP's as FRAX/pUSDC. Metapool coin
identities are:
Market Contract Direct pool coins
OUSD 0x87650d7bbfc3a9f10587d777820667171
9d9910d
OUSD and 3CRV
mUSD 0x8474ddbe98f5aa3179b3b3f5942d724af
cdec9f6
mUSD and 3CRV
FRAX 0xd632f22692fac7611d2aa1c0d552930d4
3caed3b
FRAX and 3CRV
eUSD 0xaeda92e6a3b1028edc139a4ae56ec881f
3064d4f
eUSD and FRAXBP
3CRV is 0x6c3f90f043a72fa612cbac8115ee7e52bde6e490 and FRAXBP LP is 0x3175df0976dfa876431c2e9ee6bc45b65d3473cc.
eUSD therefore shares pUSDC and FRAX connections rather than a direct 3CRV base. OUSD/FRAX proxy
getters return the meaningful ABI word with trailing zero padding; this is retained verbatim and decoded
only for the declared single-word result. Fixed-block underlying quote calls also return amounts, without
proving large-scale swaps, allowances, execution or source funding. The historical receipt study
(Appendix 8) establishes actual destination trades separately.
Underlying exchanges can transform delivered OUSD or mUSD into exact base coins. Adding base-coin
liquidity creates 3CRV claims; staking or reusing these claims does not duplicate base-pool principal.
Buying pUSDC and pUSDT need not buy pDAI directly, but can alter relative prices and induce corrective
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 225

cycles. Their direction must be evaluated through the complete closing trades. Fresh source for 3pool
and the OUSD/FRAX metapool implementation is retained; modern documentation is architectural
context, not a replacement deployment. Verified metapool source.
For OUSD, mUSD and eUSD, the current HubPool's exact historical poolRebalanceRoute(uint256,address)
getter returns zero under all sampled keys 1, 42161 and 369. The configured key-1 SpokePool still points
to 0x788e49c4e2b3414777d6671d7411951e81d35808; its old enabledDepositRoutes interface reverts in all nine probes.
Both HubPool and that SpokePool hold zero of each examined metacoin. These observations do not
inventory relayers, other spokes or every possible route. An initial probe using a different route signature
is retained but excluded from route findings; the corrected manifest uses the explorer-verified HubPool
ABI.
The assumed Across leg consequently needs an established exact-token route with funded relayers, or a
new integration that supplies compatible local issuance/conversion. Receiving a same-symbol wrapped
token is insufficient. The destination recipient must separately swap or add liquidity; delivery does not
automatically rebalance Curve. Relayers' reimbursement and outstanding LP claims remain obligations
to reconcile even under coordinated control. Copied deployment and upgrade audit (Appendix 14), 
historical Across financing model.
Reproduction and limits
The maintained manifests are the pulsechain_deferred_campaign JSON files under Research/experiments, with
explicit metadata, debt, routes, bridge and rates reads. Each getter collection runs through Research/
scripts/probe_pulsechain_routes.py with --block 0x1a649fa and a fresh output destination. Keep snapshot
identities and historical results. The new batch directory is artifacts/pulsechain-deferred-campaign-20260930/.
It retains raw RPC records, block rechecks, explorer source responses, source-index.json and the offline
model.
Reproduce the offline findings with:
python Research/scripts/model_pulsechain_deferred_campaign.py \
  --manifest Research/experiments/pulsechain_deferred_campaign_20260930.json \
  --output artifacts/pulsechain-deferred-campaign-reproduction/model.json
The model records manifest, script and evidence hashes. Its representative behavior test checks
cumulative fixed-pool impact, zero-income funding limits, preservation of productive principal and
schedule arithmetic. Production code is untouched. The full research suite is run with ./scripts/test.sh --
research. Strategy source verification, 86ff execution authority, large executable wrapper capacity,
complete Across metacoin routes, actual collected yields and robust dollar-price control remain
unresolved. The mechanism is a coherent conditional financing proposal; a multi-year operating result
has not been demonstrated.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 226
